import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 结为道侣指令
 * - /结为道侣                   → 显示我的好友（排除已有道侣关系），带分页和[结缘]按钮
 * - /结为道侣 2                 → 我的好友第2页
 * - /结为道侣 <名称|UID|@目标>         → 发起道侣申请（仅一种誓约道具时直接使用；多种时列出供选择）
 * - /结为道侣 <名称|UID|@目标> <序号>  → 直接使用第 <序号> 个誓约道具发起申请
 */
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { executeProposalCommand, getEligibleFriends } from '@src/response-apps/companion/propose/app';
import { canAccessFifthLayerFeature, sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui, GuiButton } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const fifthLayerAccess = await canAccessFifthLayerFeature(uid, bid);

  if (!fifthLayerAccess.ok) {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '结为道侣', realmName: fifthLayerAccess.realmName });

    return;
  }

  const text = e.MessageText?.trim() ?? '';
  const match = text.match(/^[!！/#＃]?结为道侣(\s+(.+))?$/);

  const args = (match?.[2]?.trim() ?? '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);

  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  let friendFacts: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof executeProposalCommand>>['preflight'] | undefined;
  const first = args[0];
  const isPureNumber = !!first && /^\d+$/.test(first);
  const rawOathIndex = args.length >= 2 && /^\d+$/.test(args[1]) ? Number(args[1]) : undefined;
  const oathIndex = rawOathIndex === undefined ? undefined : Number.isSafeInteger(rawOathIndex) ? rawOathIndex : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

  if (first && (oathIndex !== undefined || !isPureNumber || Number(first) > 100)) {
    const mentioned = !isPureNumber ? await mention.findOne() : null;
    const command = await executeProposalCommand({
      bid,
      uid,
      target: first,
      targetBid: mentioned?.data?.UserId ?? undefined,
      oathIndex,
      fallbackPage: isPureNumber ? Number(first) || 1 : 1,
      request
    });
    const { preflight } = command;

    if (command.code === 'NOT_FOUND') {
      if (!isPureNumber || oathIndex !== undefined) {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(oathIndex !== undefined ? `未找到「${first}」` : `未找到「${first}」对应的修士，请检查名称、UID 或 @目标 是否正确`);
        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }
      friendFacts = preflight;
    } else if (command.code === 'NO_OATH_ITEMS') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('你没有誓约道具，无法发起道侣申请');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('需要持有「白首盟书」或「三生同心笺」'));
      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    } else if (command.code === 'INDEX_INVALID') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`序号超出范围，可选 1~${preflight.oathItems.length}`);
      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    } else if (command.code === 'COMPLETED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(command.mutationError ?? command.result?.message ?? '发起道侣申请失败，请稍后再试');
      if (!command.mutationError && command.result?.success) {
        addOptions(md, [
          { label: '同意结缘', command: `/同意道侣 ${command.result.initiatorName}` },
          { label: '拒绝结缘', command: `/拒绝道侣 ${command.result.initiatorName}` }
        ]);
      }
      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    } else {
      const oathItems = preflight.oathItems;
      const targetName = preflight.target!.name;
      // 多种道具，提示玩家指定序号
      const selectMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      selectMd.addBold(`向「${targetName}」发起道侣申请`);
      selectMd.addNewline();
      selectMd.addText('请选择誓约道具：');
      selectMd.addNewline();
      selectMd.addNewline();

      for (let i = 0; i < oathItems.length; i++) {
        const item = oathItems[i];
        const typeLabel = item.oathType === 'advanced' ? '高级誓约' : '普通誓约';

        selectMd.addText(`【${i + 1}】${item.name}（${typeLabel}）x${item.quantity}`);
        selectMd.addNewline();
        selectMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${item.desc}`));
      }

      selectMd.addNewline();
      selectMd.addText(`请发送：/结为道侣 ${targetName} 序号`);

      const footer: GuiButton[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < oathItems.length; i++) {
        footer.push({ label: oathItems[i].name, command: `/结为道侣 ${targetName} ${i + 1}` });
      }

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '选择誓约道具', content: selectMd, footer }));

      return;
    }
  }

  // 无参数或页码 → 显示我的好友供选择
  const page = args[0] && /^\d+$/.test(args[0]) ? parseInt(args[0], 10) || 1 : 1;

  const friendData = friendFacts ?? (await getEligibleFriends({ bid, uid, page })).data;
  const { friends: eligibleFriends, currentPage, totalPages, totalCount } = friendData;

  if (totalCount === 0) {
    const noFriendMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    noFriendMd.addBold('【结为道侣】');
    noFriendMd.addNewline();
    noFriendMd.addText('当前没有可结缘的好友');
    noFriendMd.addNewline();
    noFriendMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('需要先 ').addButton('结交好友', { data: '/结交 ' }).addText('，双方成为好友后方可结缘'));

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: noFriendMd }));

    return;
  }

  const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

  contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('点击 [结缘] 向好友发起道侣申请'));

  contentMd.addText(totalPages > 1 ? '我的好友' : `我的好友（${totalCount}人）`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('要求：双方为好友且灵契值≥100，需持有誓约道具'));

  for (const friend of eligibleFriends) {
    contentMd.addText(`${friend.friendName}（${friend.friendRealm}）`);
    contentMd.addNewline();
    contentMd.addBlockquote(
      addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${friend.spiritBondLevel}（${friend.intimacy}） `), [
        { label: '结缘', command: `/结为道侣 ${friend.friendName}` }
      ])
    );

    contentMd.addNewline();
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false,
      bid,
      title: '结为道侣',
      header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/我的道侣' }],
      content: contentMd,
      nav: totalPages > 1 ? { current: currentPage, total: totalPages, count: totalCount, command: '/结为道侣 {page}' } : undefined
    })
  );
});
